title: SVP AM checklist & quick notes
content:
AM SCRATCHPAD - Maya (SVP Product)
Date: 2026-03-13

Top 3 for today (no surprises):
- Board sync prep (9:30am) — finalize 3 slides: rollout update, unit-economics, risks + mitigation. Ask Ben for the short latency-cost chart (slide 2) by 8:45.
- Customer escalation: Acme Corp outage post-deploy — escalate path, authorize incident credit, coordinate postmortem. Quick call w/CS at 10:15.
- Pricing decision for Dedicated pilot (APAC) — confirm margin floor + discount cadence. Need final number to finance by EOD.

Meetings/Prep (time -> goal -> notes):
- 8:00 AM: Daily sync (platform leads) -> unblock release gating items.
  Notes: Make sure release-engineering has the canary rollback criterion documented (SLO breach > 2x p95 for 10m). Confirm obs team adds a dashboard tile for KV cache hit rate.
- 9:30 AM: Board prep runthrough with CEO -> align ask on Dedicated commitments.
  Talking points: 1) adoption metrics (90-day), 2) cost reduction via Optimize recommendations, 3) enterprise traction (2 signed pilots).
  Quick ask: reduce slide text — CEO prefers bullets, not long sentences.
- 10:15 AM: Acme escalation (CS + Eng on call) -> triage & next steps.
  Immediate: open incident ticket INF-2417 (linked). Offer 2-day rollback window; authorize $X credit (TBD).
- 11:30 AM: Candidate deep-dive (applied-ml hire) -> prepare 3 signal questions + assignment.

Action items (explicit owners and deadlines):
- Ben (observability): deliver latency vs cost chart by 8:45 AM (today).
- Priya (finance): model Dedicated pilot pricing scenarios, include sensitivity to 10%/20% usage variance — due 5pm today.
- Connor (SRE): confirm rollback hooks and update release checklist — due noon.
- Ana (CS): draft Acme customer note (apology + next steps) and share w/legal for quick review — due 2pm.
- Me (Maya): send short note to board with 3 asks + one-pager attachment — before 5pm.

Notes to self / talking bullets for Board:
- We are seeing 12% month-over-month growth in tokens served for hosted API; uptick driven by 2 partners (healthcare proof-of-concepts).
- Cost plan: Optimize recommendations should reduce per-token cost by 18% in Q2 with batching + quantization profile. Need to call out risk of quality drift for LLM-2-7b-quant.
- Ask the board to approve a $1.2M reserved capacity pilot (6 months) to secure APAC capacity for Dedicated.

Acme incident quick log (to flesh out later):
- 03/12 22:12 UTC: deploy v1.8.3 -> customers report timeouts on long-chat sessions (>2048 tokens).
- Initial hypothesis: KV cache eviction threshold too low for our new long-context sticky sessions.
- Quick mitigation: revert KV policy OR bump memory limit on hosts. Need SRE cost estimate for extra capacity.

Draft email snippet to board (very short):
- Subject: Briefing for today’s Board sync (3 bullets)
- Body: Hi all, attaching 1-pager. TL;DR: 1) strong usage growth, 2) proposed Dedicated pilot for APAC to secure capacity, 3) request $1.2M commit. Happy to walk through at 9:30.

Open / unresolved questions (flagged):
- How confident are we in quality metrics if we push quantization on LLM-2-7b-quant? (Need eval results from research; ping Sam).
- Legal: any contractual constraint for offering credits to Acme for an infra-caused outage? (Ana to confirm).
- Ops: if we expand Dedicated pilot earlier, what is earliest provisioning lead time in APAC? (Connor to confirm).

Quick hires / people notes:
- Candidate A (applied-ml) looks promising; interview feedback: strong infra experience, needs more prompt eval experience. Assignment: small prompt-eval homework (2 hours).
- Reminder: do 1:1 with Priya on Wednesday (skip week if overloaded).

Misc scratch bits (random, jot down):
- Slack thread to follow: #customer-escalations -> thread "acme-longchat-0312"
- PR to watch: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-runtime PR#524 (KV cache fixes) — add comment re: rollback strategy.
- Quick idea: run a 48-hour "latency watch" after any major deploy — automated check that emails me if p95 > baseline*1.5. Could be low-effort SRE automation.

End-of-day quick checklist:
- send board email (done?)
- confirm Acme note sent (Ana)
- finance numbers in (Priya)
- release checklist updated (Connor)


---
Notes to self: keep this clean and move final board notes to confluence/board packet after runthrough. Save this scratchpad copy for context on follow-ups.
